claims: NASA launched the Artemis II mission on April 1, 2026.
Artemis II marks the first crewed flight to the moon in over 50 years.
The Artemis II mission has a duration of 10 days.
The Artemis II crew consists of Reid Wiseman, Victor Glover, Christina Koch, and Jeremy Hansen.
The Artemis II mission involves a lunar flyby aboard the Orion spacecraft.
The Artemis II mission tests systems before future landings.
Artemis II is part of NASA's Artemis campaign.
The objective of Artemis II is to fly around the moon and return.
Artemis II tests the Orion capsule's life support systems with a human crew.
The launch vehicle for Artemis II is the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket.
Artemis II represents the first time humans have traveled beyond low-Earth orbit since 1972.
The Orion spacecraft features a fully functional, improved toilet system.
Artemis II is a test flight preparing for future Artemis missions that will land the first woman and first person of color on the moon.
